settings.title: Introducing the Full-Option Industrial Glass Washing Machine, 2500 mm Width – Export Model
settings.text:
This machine is sized to meet the needs of tempered-glass factories. Glass washing machines are manufactured in various dimensions and can easily wash glass sheets of different widths, from very small pieces to large panels.
Thanks to technological advances, full-option washing machines are now designed to perform the washing process efficiently without requiring continuous operator intervention.
This is one of the first machines used in a double-glazed glass production line. Manufacturers therefore offer a wide range of models so that businesses can select a machine with dimensions suited to their specific requirements.
The full-option industrial glass washing machine, 2500 mm width, export model, is considered a leading product in this field and is popular for its range of features and technical specifications.

settings.title: Why Are Glass Washing Machines Essential in Production Lines?
settings.text:
Looking at a double-glazed window production line makes it clear why the washing machine must be among the first machines in the manufacturing process.
If even a small stain remains on the glass surface, it becomes impossible to access the inner surfaces after the double-glazing process is complete, and the stain remains trapped inside the finished unit.
Traditional manual washing may leave grease, stains, or even fabric fibres on the glass. A full-option glass washing machine should therefore be used to achieve an optimal final result.
With the 2500 mm wide export-model full-option washing machine, not only is washing quality significantly improved, but the process is also faster than with other machines or manual methods. This, in turn, increases production output.

settings.title: Technical Specifications of the Full-Option Glass Washing Machine
settings.text:
Among the wide range of glass washing machines available, the 2500 mm wide export-model full-option machine stands out for its strong technical specifications.
Since this machine is continuously exposed to water and moisture, all its components must be manufactured to resist moisture and prevent corrosion.
Below are some of the most important technical specifications of this full-option washing machine:
The machine is equipped with an intelligent French electrical control panel incorporating the latest safety features, helping protect operators during use.
Its body is coated with electrostatic powder paint cured in an oven, providing good resistance to water and moisture.
The machine features a high-pressure hot-air centrifugal blower and operates with a robust bearing assembly and heavy-duty chain, while producing minimal noise.
All major sections, including the washing-water tanks, are made from polyethylene panels that offer excellent resistance to corrosion.
The machine is fitted with water-cleaning filters that remove contaminants over time and help prevent washing with poor-quality water.
High-quality brushes carry out the washing process without scratching the glass. Their higher bristle density also improves cleaning performance.
The machine can easily wash glass sheets ranging from 20 × 20 cm up to 3.21 × 2.5 m.
The rollers that move the glass do not absorb dirt or grease. They run smoothly and help prevent excessive pressure on the glass surface.
The machine has two hot-water tanks, used separately for washing and rinsing. The water in these tanks is heated by dedicated electric heating elements.

settings.title: Special Features of the Export-Model Full-Option Glass Washing Machine
settings.text:
The 2500 mm wide export-model full-option washing machine uses hot water throughout the washing process to remove grease completely from the glass surface.
Its specifications show that the machine's components and operating stages are designed to a high standard.
Some of its distinctive features include:
• Washing glass with thicknesses from 2 to 10 mm
• Emergency stop buttons in two locations on the machine
• A washing-quality inspection section with an LED light at the outlet, allowing operators to inspect the glass more clearly after washing
• A phase-control system for improved machine protection
• Six high-absorption foam rollers and a hot-air blowing system for more effective glass drying
• Washing different types of glass, including tempered, reflective, and clear glass
• An automatic height-adjustment system for washing glass of different thicknesses
• Adjustable glass-conveying speed

settings.text:
Using advanced, automated machinery offers many benefits to industrial operators.
The 2500 mm wide export-model full-option washing machine also provides numerous advantages, making it a preferred choice for many tempered-glass manufacturers.
Its key benefits include:

• Faster glass washing and time savings
• High washing quality with lower water consumption
• Reduced need for skilled operators to run the machine
• Increased production speed
• An 18-month Gold Warranty with access to various support services
